title: Breaking out of a tight base: is there a rule, known at the close, for the next session's run?
hypothesis: A liquid stock that closes above its previous 20-session high out of a tight base (previous 20-session range under 15% of the price), or that sits in such a base near its top, earns more than the average liquid stock the next session (open to close) and over 5 sessions.
closed_without_a_new_study: The three HELD_INTO_FALL drafts approved 31 Oct (CTL, PULL, REV) ask whether a faster exit is justified. RX1 (X|PULL, X|CTL, X|CTL_downtrend) and RX2 (X|REV) already tested the faster exit the reconstruction can propose (out at the 4th session's open when the first 3 sessions never reached a quarter of the risk): all OPPOSITE. They are recorded as answered, not re-tested, so no variant is spent on them.

data.stock_panel: gold/teachers/stock_panel.parquet 2000-2023 (o, h, l, c, liq_rank, breakout20, pos20, fwd5), as RX1

definitions.universe: liquid stocks: liq_rank <= 250 on the signal day; the base for every comparison is all liquid stocks on the same next session (RX1's level rule)
definitions.base20: (highest high - lowest low of the previous 20 sessions) / the previous close; tight = base20 <= 0.15 (the missed-movers rule, india/missed.py BASE_TIGHT)
definitions.breakout_base: close above the highest high of the previous 20 sessions and tight base20, with a consecutive previous bar
definitions.base_near_top: tight base20, not a breakout, and the close in the top fifth of the 20-session range (pos20 >= 0.8): the setup visible before a breakout
definitions.outcomes: next_oc = next session open to close; fwd5 = close to the close 5 sessions later (as RX1); next-session moves over 50% dropped

statistics.level: india.teachers_stock.level: per calendar quarter, signal mean minus all liquid stocks' mean; t across quarters

bar.note: RX2's 152 plus these 3; k frozen at 155

not_claimed: Research only; no rule changes. A pass would be a proposal for a 20-session paper trial and Madhav's yes.
